newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danske Bank issues share index-linked bond.
newsitem.headline: Danske Bank issues share index-linked bond.

text.p: Den Danske Bank, Denmark's biggest bank, is to issue a new four-year bond linked to European shares rather than bearing conventional interest.

A company statement said that the paper, on sale in Denmark from October 21 to November 1, would be linked to a basket of European bourse share indexes and that the initial offer would be at least 100 million crowns.

"The new paper is primarily directed at private investors. On expiry the investor will receive his initial investment back plus 100 percent of any rise in price that has accrued on the various European markets," it said.
The bond is to be listed on Copenhagen Stock Exchange on November 11, it said.
